buildings.name: Library
buildings.unlockedMessage: The seals break... You have unlocked Cole Library, where knowledge and quiet whispers guard Eros' forgotten words.
buildings.description: Cole Library is the academic heart of Cornell College, offering vast resources, quiet study spaces, and a space for community to gather.

buildings.name: McWethy
buildings.unlockedMessage: The colors return... McWethy Hall awakens, and the universe opens up to you. Just outside is Jupiter, a gas giant in the Solar System and the father of Venus.
buildings.description: McWethy Hall is home to Cornell’s art programs, where creativity thrives. See also the to-scale Solar System art installation on the Jupiter plaque just outside. The installation begins in downtown MV with the Sun, goes along first street, and ends down the old Lincoln highway.

buildings.name: PR
buildings.unlockedMessage: The silence lifts... Pauly Rorem opens, revealing where Eros dreamed restless dreams under moonlit nights.
buildings.description: Pauly Rorem is a welcoming residence hall, offering a close-knit community for students living on the Hilltop campus.

buildings.name: Ebersole
buildings.unlockedMessage: The healing hum returns... Ebersole opens, where Eros once sought comfort when hope began to fade.
buildings.description: The Ebersole Health & Wellness Center provides physical and mental health support for all Cornell students, offering a safe space for care and recovery.

buildings.name: Stoner
buildings.unlockedMessage: The winds shift... Stoner House welcomes you, where Eros found kinship among voices from every corner of the world.
buildings.description: Stoner House serves as the hub for international students, celebrating diversity and fostering global community on campus.

buildings.name: TC
buildings.unlockedMessage: The echoes awaken... Thomas Commons opens, where Eros once gathered, laughed, and lingered in the heart of campus life.
buildings.description: Thomas Commons is the central hub of Cornell College, offering dining, gathering spaces, and student resources for every part of campus life.

buildings.name: SAW
buildings.unlockedMessage: The spirit stirs... Small Athletic Center awakens, where Eros once pushed limits and found strength in every stride.
buildings.description: The Small Athletic Center is Cornell College's premier fitness facility, featuring state-of-the-art equipment, courts, and spaces for athletic training and wellness.
